caption: The drawing depicts an upright pipe organ constructed primarily of polished brown wood, featuring intricate carvings and ornate designs on its frame, columns, and panels. The central upper section of the organ showcases a row of vertical golden pipes, surrounded by decorative woodwork with floral and geometric motifs. Below the pipes, there are multiple round stops or buttons in white and dark shades, arranged above a single manual keyboard with white and black keys. Below the keyboard, there are two rectangular foot pedal boards angled outward, decorated with a floral pattern in green, yellow, and red colors. The overall composition is centered on the organ, which roughly occupies the middle of a plain, off-white background, with no other objects present.
title: Church Organ
